rv.q: In addition to the magnetic relationship between Kim and Ellen, the careful balance of comedy and horror gives WHERE DEAD WOMEN GO TO DANCE its vibrant charm.
Stephen Spotswood pens a spellbinding ode to the ones we lost along the way.
The production is such an important one because of the myriad of difficult topics it tackles.

cn.t: Critics praise this dark, witchy comedy as a spellbinding ode to friendship and loss, with Spotswood's world premiere earning strong notices for its powerful exploration of grief and reanimation through magical realism.
